name: Dual Antipodal VC Dimension of Full Cube
proof: For a dually antipodally shattered set of $d$ cube functions, the $n$ coordinates must realize all $2^{d-1}$ complementary pairs of $d$-bit patterns, so $2^{d-1}\leq n$. Conversely, for $d=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$, choose $d$ functions whose values on $2^{d-1}$ coordinates are one representative from every complementary pair; assign their remaining values arbitrarily. These functions are dually antipodally shattered.
